slug: 看守废丹房三年我偷偷成仙了
lines: 观玄界。
东域。
摇光圣地。
“你我缘分已尽，自今日起，婚书作废。”
“你若答应，便拿着这袋灵石离开圣地。”
“往后若遇麻烦，看在咱们两家昔年的交情上，我可以出手帮你一次。”
杂役小院，黑袍遮掩身形的倾城女子，玉手伸出，将储物袋放在了秦凡眼前。
女子谪仙子般的容貌，眸若星辰，气质清冷，淡淡的体香迎面吹拂，让秦凡立马从惊愕中回神过来。
什么情况？
这刚穿过来，手里香喷喷的软饭还没来得及吃，这就要飞走了？
太倒霉了吧。
不死心的秦凡还想再挽回一下，犹豫问道：“我真的没机会了吗？”
“我如今是圣地圣女，你不过一品灵根天赋，杂役弟子，你我完全两个世界的人，直白一点来说……”
“没有。”
颜暮雪毫不客气的给了拒绝。
唉！
秦凡心下轻叹，还想着一人得道鸡犬升天，轻轻松松就完成长生不死的伟大愿景。
不曾想，还是要自己奋斗。
也罢，事已至此，只能吃点苦了。
摸了摸腰间，嗯，天赋虽然差了些，但有宝贝，倒也不是完全没机会渡劫成仙。
“那好吧，我答应了。”
“但我不会离开圣地。”
“所以，咳，我还配拥有这些灵石吗？”
秦凡眼神闪烁，不好意思的将手伸向了储物袋。
然而，颜暮雪却眉头一皱，放下伸出的手，问道：“为什么？”
秦凡抓了个空，嘴角微抽，无奈说道：“我也想追寻一下长生大道，这不过分吧？”
“一品灵根？”
“那咋了？”
颜暮雪微微沉默，“十天后，杂役考核，排在末尾的人会被淘汰，你过不去的。”
秦凡愣了，“杂役弟子什么时候搞的末位淘汰制？”
“我会向师尊提议的。”
“还有，你我之间的事，我不希望有第三个人知道。”
content_en:
Guanxuan world.
Eastern Region.
Shaking Light Holy Land.
"The fate between you and me has ended. From today on, the marriage contract is invalid."
"If you agree, take this bag of spiritual stones and leave the Holy Land."
"If you encounter trouble in the future, I can help you because of the friendship between our two families in the past."
In the courtyard of the handyman, a beautiful woman with a black robe covering her figure stretched out her beautiful hand and placed the storage bag in front of Qin Fan.
The woman's appearance was like a fairy, her eyes were like stars, her temperament was cold, and her faint body fragrance blew in his face, making Qin Fan immediately recover from his shock.
What's going on?
I just walked through it, and I haven’t had time to eat the delicious soft rice in my hand. Is it about to fly away?
How unlucky.
Unwilling to give up, Qin Fan still wanted to save something, so he hesitated and asked, "Do I really have no chance?"
"I am now the Saint of the Holy Land. You are only a first-grade spiritual root talent and a handyman disciple. You and I are completely different people from different worlds. To put it bluntly..."
"No."
Yan Muxue refused unceremoniously.
well!
Qin Fan sighed softly in his heart, still thinking about the great vision of one person attaining the Tao, chickens and dogs ascending to heaven, and achieving immortality easily.
I never thought that I would still have to fight on my own.
No matter what, things have come to this, and I can only suffer a little.
Touching his waist, well, although his talent is a bit lacking, but with the treasure, it's not like he has no chance of overcoming the disaster and becoming an immortal.
"Okay, I agree."
"But I will not leave the Holy Land."
"So, hey, do I still deserve to have these spiritual stones?"
Qin Fan's eyes flickered and he reached out to the storage bag sheepishly.
However, Yan Muxue frowned, put down her outstretched hand, and asked, "Why?"
Qin Fan took a moment, twitched his lips slightly, and said helplessly: "I also want to pursue the road to immortality. Isn't this too much?"
"First-grade spiritual root?"
"What happened?"
Yan Muxue was slightly silent, "Ten days later, there will be a handyman assessment. Those at the bottom will be eliminated. You won't be able to pass."
Qin Fan was stunned, "When did the handyman disciples implement the elimination system for the last place?"
"I will propose it to Master."
"Also, I don't want a third person to know about what's going on between you and me."
